purpose: Current architecture ablations with independent public-pretrained starts
dataset: AgCNER original train/dev; test evaluated separately after choices fixed
independent_seed_start: public encoder weights, fresh task modules; no AgCNER parent checkpoint
phase_transfer: same variant and seed prior phase best; reset optimizer, scheduler and EMA
selection: raw dev exact original char-span/type Micro; live vs EMA each epoch; B/C include epoch0; strict improvement; earlier/live wins ties
CRF: BIOES NLL, boundary kept; no GP-specific weighting; window emissions averaged before sentence Viterbi
candidate_sources_and_calibration: This package trains single models and exports raw predictions; later common calibration/evaluation separate
source_data_usage: train-only lexicon/character IDs/type frequency; dev for model selection
primary_dev_metric: raw Micro F1; report Macro13 and per-type counts alongside
phase_random_stream: new phase resets model RNG to seed+rank; exact checkpoint RNG restored on resume
